Aquafaba holds more water than egg. When you replace whole eggs, reduce the other water or milk in the recipe by 5 to 10% and bake fully. This matters most for brownies, loaf cakes and enriched breads. When you replace egg whites only, leave the other ingredients as they are.

Match the mixing method to the job the egg normally does. Whip chilled aquafaba for foam in a sponge, génoise or meringue. Add it straight in where you need binding, softness or moisture. In fat-rich batters, mix it with sugar before the fat. In high-sugar batters, whip it with part of the sugar first and fold gently.
